notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for dimension handle, name, upper-bound, and available-dimension lookup across connection, membership, resign, invalid-input, and cross-federate identity boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador API and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It deliberately stops at dimension metadata and class associations, without region creation or provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador dimension handle/name/upper-bound and available-dimension lookup across lifecycle boundaries
